correlated_incident.instructions: Do the available signal decisions describe one correlated production incident?

incident_kind.instructions: Choose the incident that best explains all available signal decisions.

criteria.healthy: The available signals are normal or isolated noise without user impact.
criteria.db_pool_exhaustion: Metrics show pool saturation, traces show database waiting, and logs show pool timeouts.
criteria.downstream_timeout: A non-database dependency consistently dominates errors and latency.
criteria.deploy_regression: A recent deployment causes application failures without dependency saturation.
criteria.insufficient_evidence: Signals are missing or contradict each other too strongly to select an incident.
